_note: APLIIQ capsule spec — the product list the storefront sells. `npm run apliiq:capsule -- create|map` (APLIIQ designs + sellable registry), `node scripts/square-capsule.mjs create|images|copy|manifest <slug>` (Square item + imagery + story + manifest row), `python3 scripts/imagery/render-product-imagery.py <slug>` (studio imagery). See docs/content-swap-guide.md. Retail in cents; sizeRetail overrides per size; story is the PDP copy (HTML).
